items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 13 November 2026 12:01am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 12:01am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Cold start with a patchy frost in sheltered areas as well as high ground. Then a few showers developing around dawn that may lift temperatures. Otherwise, bright or sunny spells between the showers later this morning before becoming dry with sunny spells in the afternoon. Light to moderate mainly westerly wind, backing southwest and freshening later, maximum temperature of 9°C.

Largely cloudy with a few showers at times. Moderate to fresh southwest wind, steadily strengthening through the day, highest temperature 11°C.


##Outlook##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain at times. Fresh to strong south or southwest wind, backing east. Top temperature 11°C.
